## What changed

Describe the method, teaching, documentation, or packaging change in plain language.

## Why it belongs

Which contribution test does this pass?

- [ ] Collects for a named discipline
- [ ] Fuses named disciplines
- [ ] Consumes fused evidence into a named decision artifact
- [ ] Diffs a named prior run
- [ ] Improves an existing Project surface without adding a skill

## Safety and rights

- [ ] I did not include a client or customer name, employer-confidential material, personal information, or real competitive research about a named company.
- [ ] I created this contribution or have permission to submit it.
- [ ] Any teaching example is labeled synthetic and uses `example.invalid` URLs.
- [ ] I have read and agree to [`CONTRIBUTOR-TERMS.md`](../CONTRIBUTOR-TERMS.md). I retain ownership and grant 280 Group LLC dba Productside the rights stated there.

## Skill contract, when applicable

- [ ] I read `docs/SKILL-SPEC.md` before editing `skills/`.
- [ ] A new skill was added to `SKILL_REGISTRY` first.
- [ ] The required skill, template, worked example, and weak example files are present.
- [ ] The output remains aligned with `reference/output-schemas.md`.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran `./scripts/test-library.sh` and it passed.

## Notes for the reviewer

List tradeoffs, unresolved questions, or parts where practitioner judgment is especially important. Response times vary.
